title: Signal 11 Editor crash when setting a StringName variable of a Resource with a String inside a tool script
body: ### Tested versions 4.5.stable - 4.6.stable ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9700K CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads) - 63.91 GiB memory ### Issue description I'm inside a plugin ui script written in gdscript that sets a StringName variable of a resource. when i don't type cast the LineEdits String with "as StringName" the editor will signal 11 crash: the docs of StringName say that the Strings are auto converted from String to StringName when the functions parameter is StringName. when i try the same setup as below within one script without the resource, it also works as expected. so it somehow has to do with that the StringName is within a Resource as @ export variable. probably also important that i'm within a tool script. ### Steps to reproduce ```gdscript extends Resource class_name Test @export var name: StringName = "Peter" ``` ```gdscript @tool extends Control var test :Test = Test.new() @export var internal_test :StringName = &"hello" @onready line_edit : LineEdit = %LineEdit func get_line_input(): test.name = line_edit.text # "as StringName" is needed or the editor will signal 11 crash. internal_test = line_edit.text # works as expected. ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
